lines.text: بو لجاج و مجادله و ستیزه کردن و ناراستی در مردم و بسیاری دروغ و سفاهت و قحط
lines.en: to obstinacy, disputation, and quarreling, and dishonesty among the people, and much lying, and foolishness, and famine.

lines.text: (قران عطارد و مریخ در مثلثات آتشی) دلالت کند بر ساختن آلت حرب و حرکت
lines.en: (The conjunction of Mercury and Mars in the fiery triplicities) indicates the making of weapons of war and the movement

lines.text: لشکریان و غضب سفاهت در میان مردم و زحمت ارباب قلم و تجار و اهل بازار و
lines.en: of armies, and the anger of foolishness among the people, and trouble for the masters of the pen, and merchants, and the people of the bazaar, and

lines.text: تهمت و غمز و خیانت متصرفان و متصدیان و محاسبه ایشان و بسیاری اراجیف و
lines.en: accusation, and slander, and the treachery of the possessors and the managers, and their accounting, and many false rumors, and

lines.text: اخبار بد و فتنه و غوغا خاصه در اقلیم سیم و ششم و سایر بلاد و زدن دراهم فلوس و
lines.en: bad news, and sedition, and clamor, especially in the third and sixth climes, and other cities, and the striking of copper dirhams, and

lines.text: قلب و فساد طراران و بد فعلان و ظهور مدعیان کیمیا و غلبه دزدان و خشکی هوا
lines.en: counterfeiting, and the corruption of pickpockets and evildoers, and the appearance of claimants of alchemy, and the overcoming of thieves, and the dryness of the air,

lines.text: و ظهور علامات آسمانی و داغ دواب (اگر در حمل بود) دلالت کند بر حرب در
lines.en: and the appearance of heavenly signs, and the branding of beasts. (If it is in Aries) it indicates war in

lines.text: ولایت شام و عرب و قلت آب چشمه‌ها و قتال میانه ابنای پادشاه در ولایت روم
lines.en: the province of Syria and Arabia, and the scarcity of water in springs, and fighting among the sons of the king in the province of Rome,

lines.text: و ترکستان و خروج لشکر از طرف مغرب و فساد و غارت کردن و حدوث امراض از تبها
lines.en: and Turkestan, and the emergence of an army from the west, and corruption and looting, and the occurrence of diseases from fevers

lines.text: و اوجاع بواسیر و رعد و برق و باران و ساختن آلت حرب و رغبت مردم بفتنه و خصومت
lines.en: and the pains of hemorrhoids, and thunder, and lightning, and rain, and the making of weapons of war, and the inclination of the people to sedition and enmity,

lines.text: تجار و اهل بازار و خواست و طلب زرغایا و وقوع تهمتها و ظهور کذابان و اهل
lines.en: merchants, and the people of the bazaar, and the desire and demand for gold from the subjects, and the occurrence of accusations, and the appearance of liars, and the people of

lines.text: نفاق و سفها و زحمت عمال و کتاب و اراجیف و خیانتها در مردم و قطع طرق و فتنه
lines.en: hypocrisy, and fools, and trouble for the agents and scribes, and false rumors, and treacheries among the people, and the cutting of roads, and sedition

lines.text: در زمین مشرق و زدن درمهای قلب و بانگ بوق و دهل در میان اهل بازار و میدان
lines.en: in the land of the east, and the striking of counterfeit dirhams, and the sound of the horn and drum among the people of the bazaar and the square,

lines.text: و جمع آمدن معرکه گیران و شعبدان و منازعه صناع و اهل حرفه اگر مریخ مستعلی بود
lines.en: and the gathering of street performers and jugglers, and the dispute of artisans and tradesmen. If Mars is elevated,

lines.text: در زمین شام فتنه باشد و دشمن در دیار عرب خرابی کند و باران ابد و اگر عطارد
lines.en: there will be sedition in the land of Syria, and the enemy will cause ruin in the lands of Arabia, and rain will fall. And if Mercury

lines.text: مستعلی بود میانه اهل روم و دشمن مجادله و مقاتله افتد و هلاک بزرگی در آن بلاد
lines.en: is elevated, there will be disputation and fighting between the people of Rome and the enemy, and the destruction of a great one in those cities

lines.text: افتد و خشم و بیماری و سختی گرما بود (و اگر در اسد بود) دلالت کند بر گرما و
lines.en: will occur, and anger, disease, and the severity of heat will be. (And if it is in Leo) it indicates heat and

lines.text: خشکی هوا و بسیاری شهب و اخبار مخوفه و اراجیف و حیلت خلایق و فساد معادن
lines.en: the dryness of the air, and many shooting stars, and fearful news, and false rumors, and the trickery of the creatures, and the corruption of mines,

lines.text: و عزیمت آلت حرب و ستور و بیماری و سبی و سفک دماء و مجادله و مخاربه در زمین
lines.en: and the setting out of weapons of war, and beasts of burden, and disease, and captivity, and the shedding of blood, and disputation, and warfare in the land of

lines.text: فارس و هلاك اعدا و پادشاه و موت در کتاب و ارباب نقوش و حرب میان اهل
lines.en: Fars, and the destruction of enemies and the king, and death among the scribes and the masters of designs, and war among the people of

lines.text: مغرب و مشرق و ارزانی برده و کثرت ریاح با گرد و غبار و قلت باران و کثرت گرما
lines.en: the west and the east, and the cheapness of slaves, and the abundance of winds with dust, and the scarcity of rain, and the abundance of heat,

lines.text: و منازعه میان اهل قلم و خداوندان سلاح و تقریر و تشنیع در میان ایشان و زیادت
lines.en: and dispute among the people of the pen and the masters of weapons, and speech and reproach among them, and an increase

lines.en: of soldiers over the people of virtue and piety, and the perishing of quadrupeds. If Mars is elevated, the death of one of

summary.headline: Mercury and Mars in Fire Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mercury and Mars in the fiery triplicities, with separate indications for Aries and Leo. The text forecasts war, famine, sedition, counterfeit dirhams, diseases, weather phenomena, regional conflicts, and effects of elevated Mars or Mercury.
